name: SAUNABOX Solara 2-Person: Full Spectrum Infrared Sauna
description: Your personal infrared sanctuary, reimagined. The Solara delivers the deep restorative power of full-spectrum heat and medical-grade red light therapy, refined into a sleek, two-person, beautifully crafted wooden sauna for your home. Every detail of The Solara has been designed for both function and elegance. Eight Carbon Coated ThermoCell Infrared Panels deliver 1,800W of ultra-low EMF heat, while a front-mounted, full-length 660nm + 850nm Red Light and Near Infrared panel works in tandem to accelerate recovery at a cellular level. With a matte black exterior, full-length reflective tempered glass door, and RGB LED chromotherapy lighting, The Solara is as striking to look at as it is to sit inside. Crafted from 100% Canadian Hemlock with a matte black painted exterior finish, The Solara reaches 150°F in approximately 25 minutes and fits two people comfortably, bringing the benefits of professional-grade recovery into your daily rhythm. It's innovation, with intention. Wellness, without compromise. KEY FEATURES: → Full Spectrum Low-EMF Infrared Heating → Certified Free of Toxic Heavy Metals & Phthalates → Bluetooth Speaker System → Medical Grade 660nm Red Light Therapy → 850nm Near Infrared Therapy → Reflective Glass Door for Privacy → 100% Canadian Hemlock Wood → Free Curbside Delivery: Requires At Least 2 People SPECIFICATIONS: Max Temperature: 158°F (heat-up approx. 25 min) Infrared Type: Near, Mid and Far Infrared (NIR, MIR, FIR) Time Settings: 0 to 90 minutes Heaters: 8x Carbon Coated ThermoCell Infrared Panels Sauna Power: 1,800W Red Light Power: 273W Total Power: 2,073W (50/60Hz) Plug / Circuit: 20A NEMA 5-20 grounded outlet Red Light Therapy: 660nm / 850nm full-body panel Red Light Therapy: 180 LEDs deliver up to 192 mW/cm² of irradiance Interior Lighting: RGB LED chromotherapy strip Audio: Bluetooth + FM Radio + USB Interior Wood: Canadian Hemlock, light-toned, low-resin, low-odor Exterior Finish: Matte black painted Canadian Hemlock Door: Full-length reflective tempered glass, black frame Seating: Two-person bench with backrest Floor: Slatted hemlock flooring Hardware: Black hinges, handle, and accessories External Dimensions: 51"W x 41"D x 71"H Internal Dimensions: 50"W x 41"D x 70"H Unit Net Weight: 309 lb Warranty: 2-Year
